constraints.name: status_allowed
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['DRAFT'::character varying, 'OPEN'::character varying, 'CLOSED'::character varying, 'CANCELLED'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: state_allowed

constraints.name: kind_allowed
constraints.definition: CHECK (((kind)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['RECEIVE'::character varying, 'TRANSFER'::character varying, 'ADJUST'::character varying, 'RETURN'::character varying, 'DISPATCH'::character varying, 'ACCEPT'::character varying, 'RECALL'::character varying, 'DAMAGE'::character varying, 'REPAIR'::character varying, 'DISPOSE'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: fk_hold_line
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (sale_id, line_no) REFERENCES sale_lines(sale_id, line_no)

constraints.name: ck_location_kind
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((kind)::text = 'BOOTH'::text) AND (booth_id IS NOT NULL)) OR (((kind)::text <> 'BOOTH'::text) AND (booth_id IS NULL))))

constraints.name: kind_allowed
constraints.definition: CHECK (((kind)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['WAREHOUSE'::character varying, 'BOOTH'::character varying, 'TRANSIT'::character varying, 'DAMAGED'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: ck_transfer_received_complete
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((state)::text <> 'RECEIVED'::text) OR ((received_quantity IS NOT NULL) AND (damaged_quantity IS NOT NULL) AND (missing_quantity IS NOT NULL) AND (((received_quantity + damaged_quantity) + missing_quantity) = quantity))))

constraints.name: ck_user_salesperson_role
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((role)::text = 'OWNER'::text) AND (salesperson_id IS NULL)) OR (((role)::text = 'SALESPERSON'::text) AND (salesperson_id IS NOT NULL))))
